title: React Performance Optimization Checklist
content:
✅ Use React.memo for pure functional components
✅ Use useMemo to memoize expensive calculations
✅ Use useCallback for stable function references
✅ Avoid unnecessary state updates
✅ Implement code splitting with React.lazy
✅ Optimize image sizes and formats
✅ Use virtualization for large lists
✅ Remove unused dependencies
✅ Analyze bundle size using source-map-explorer
✅ Test performance with React DevTools Profiler

Notes:
- Focus on reducing re-renders in the Notes page.
- Check if category filtering triggers unnecessary component updates.
- Measure First Contentful Paint (FCP) after optimizations.
